name: Purpose 2 Choice
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for the payment transaction.|Usage: Purpose is used by the end-customers, that is initiating party, (ultimate) debtor, (ultimate) creditor to provide information concerning the nature of the payment. Purpose is a content element, which is not used for processing by any of the agents involved in the payment chain.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Underlying reason for the payment transaction, as published in an external purpose code list.
